description: This file defines a Flutter widget called LazyLoad that implements lazy loading behavior for child widgets, such as images, by deferring their construction until they are near or in the viewport. It uses scroll context information to determine when to load the actual content versus showing a placeholder.

classes.name: LazyLoad
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that manages lazy loading of its child widget based on scroll position

classes.name: _LazyLoadState
classes.description: State class for LazyLoad that handles the logic for deferring widget build until near viewport

methods.name: didChangeDependencies
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when dependencies change; recalculates whether to load content

methods.name: didUpdateWidget
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when widget configuration updates; recalculates loading if preload distance changed

methods.name: _recomputeShouldLoad
methods.description: Determines whether to load the child widget based on viewport proximity using Flutter's recommendation API

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds either the loaded child widget or the placeholder based on whether loading is deferred
